text.p: INDIA: Delhi shares rise in hectic afternoon trade
Delhi stocks moved up in hectic afternoon trade on Tuesday despite political uncertainties due to heavy purchases by speculators and foreign institutional investors (FIIs), brokers said.

They said the buying sentiment was helped by a report in the Economic Times newspaper that a committee to recommend revisions in the carry-forward system of trading in stocks would make favourable changes.
At 12.45 p.m (0715 GMT), the benchmark index was 6.04 points higher at 871.65.
"Speculative buying in automobile and multinational companies pushed up shares prices," said Vijay Aggarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Reliance Industries was trading 2.0 rupees higher at 348.50. TISCO gained 5.0 rupees at 207.25 rupees and SmithKline Beecham Consumer Health 9.05 rupees at 349.0.
Bajaj Auto rose 12.0 rupees to 920.0, while TELCO rose 5.0 rupees to 396.0.
